description: This file defines a Java class `UndoWriteOffLoanCommandHandler` that handles the undo write-off command for a loan in the Fineract platform. It implements the `NewCommandSourceHandler` interface and uses the `LoanWritePlatformService` to perform the operation.

classes.name: UndoWriteOffLoanCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the undo write-off command for loans, by invoking the corresponding service method.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the undo write-off command by calling the `undoWriteOff` method on the `LoanWritePlatformService` with the loan ID extracted from the command.
